text:
rana: Heads-up: seeing a small but steady rise in fncall schema rejects in eu-central since 09:02 UTC. Top reject reason = INVALID_TOOL_SHAPE.
sam: Yep, alerts hit my pager. Looks correlated with the validator strictness canary that rolled at 08:45.
viv: Canary set to 12% in eu-central per deploybot. Did we change any adapter defaults recently?
rana: Sample (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "shipment_quote",
  "payload": {
    "price": 12.5,
    "meta": null
  },
  "req": "r_7x9b"
}
```
Validator expects meta to be an object, not null.
sam: I found a path in adapter v4.0 where meta is intentionally null to represent empty. Bad idea with the new schema.
viv: Quick workaround: we can flip soft-validate for impacted tenant shards to avoid customer 400s while we patch. ops?
ops: Can do. Which shards/tenants? Provide list and ETA for patch and well annotate incident.
rana: Affected tenants: t-21, t-22. Patch ETA ~20m, tests passing locally.
daria: UX/console request: can we surface a per-reject `raw_sample_link` (permissioned) and a `reject_type` column in the rejects table? Right now sampling masks nulls so triage is slow.
sam: Also propose adding `validator.mode` and `canary_pct` as trace tags so alerts/traces show rollout state. Right now we lose context when correlating rejects to rollouts.
viv: Important: discuss auto-fallback. If strict-validator causes >X% hard rejects sustained for Y minutes, do we auto-route that slice to the permissive variant?
ops: Policy currently manual for fncall. Auto-fallback exists for general model-degen routing but not for validator-induced rejects.
daria: Console feature idea: `auto-fallback-on-validator-spike` toggle with three knobs: threshold_percent, duration_minutes, and cooldown_minutes. Add audit trail and per-tenant opt-out checkbox.
sam: Ops concern: auto-fallback reduces 400s but may increase latency and token cost if we fall back to larger variant. Need estimated cost delta surfaced in the toggle UI before enabling.
rana: Good call. Add a small cost-estimate panel showing expected p50 latency delta and estimated monthly token cost increase for the affected slice. Compute from recent traffic and model variant profiles.
viv: Telemetry additions: metrics fncall.validator.hard_rejects, fncall.validator.soft_validations, and fncall.validator.fallbacks_triggered by region+tenant+rollout_slice. Also emit a tag `validator.rollback_reason` when ops flips the toggle.
daria: RBAC: raw_sample_link must be gated to SRE+Platform+owner role and logged. Retention policy: 1% of raw rejects kept for 14 days in secure bucket; PII review required before expanding.
sam: Quick patch pushed to adapters to normalize null/array => {} for meta. Cutting release in 12m. Will coordinate with ops to flip soft-validate back once we see rejects drop.
ops: Enabled soft-validate on t-21/t-22. Watching error budget. Will post incident #4132.
console-bot: deploybot: canary roll (validator-strictness) set to 12% in eu-central at 08:45 UTC by viv
console-bot: opsbot: incident #4132 created "fncall validator rejects spike - eu-central" assigned to eng-platform
rana: Quick poll: react with :+1: if you want auto-fallback enabled by default for emergency toggles, :eyes: if you prefer manual only.
sam: Also, please add a console graph sparkline: rejects pct vs canary pct over last 60m. That makes it obvious when the rollout needle lines up with rejects.
daria: I'll scope a UX ticket: add raw_sample column (permissioned), reject_type column, cost-estimate panel for fallback toggle, and audit trail for auto-fallback actions.
viv: Thanks all. I'll watch the patch rollout and update this thread when I revert soft-validate.
rana: Thanks. Once patch lands let's run a 5m canary health check (rejects <0.5%) before reverting.
console-bot: opsbot: incident #4132 updated (status: monitoring)
